items.prompt: A condition has 1% prevalence. A test has 99% sensitivity and 95% specificity. Given a positive test, what is the probability of the condition?

items.prompt: In the standard Monty Hall setup, you initially choose one of 3 doors, the host knows the prize location and always opens a different losing door. What is the probability of winning if you switch?
items.lessonRule: Condition on the host policy: the initial choice retains its prior probability and the remaining unopened alternative inherits the probability mass of all initially unchosen doors.

lessonTemplate.rule: Condition on the host policy: the initial choice retains its prior probability and the remaining unopened alternative inherits the probability mass of all initially unchosen doors.
contraindications: This rule requires an informed host who always opens losing doors according to the declared protocol.
